about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Gesture: Battle Cry

Get pumped up with a resounding battle cry!
Enjoy communicating and taking pictures with friends while using special gestures!

*This content can be used from "Communication," or from 'Gestures' in photo mode.

*This product is also available as part of a set. Please be careful of duplicate transactions.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
